description: RED check: p99 latency for the checkout endpoint since a given window start. Verifier-only.

configuration.query: FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE span.name == "POST /checkout" AND @timestamp >= ?window_start | STATS p99_ns = PERCENTILE(duration, 99) | EVAL p99_ms = ROUND(p99_ns / 1000000, 1)

window_start.description: Start of the verification window, bound to the executor's receipt applied_at timestamp, not now-minus-N-minutes
